properties.description: An American service brand that provides a centralized platform for booking fitness classes and wellness appointments at thousands of local studios. Founded in New York City, it transformed the fitness industry by offering a subscription-based model that allows users to access diverse workouts without being tethered to a single gym. Its service caters to active, urban-based individuals who prioritize flexibility and variety in their exercise routines. By acting as a digital marketplace, it bridge the gap between boutique fitness studios and health-conscious consumers.
properties.audience_identity: People who value variety and spontaneity in their wellness routines and prefer the freedom to explore different fitness studios without committing to a single membership.
properties.short_description: ClassPass is a fitness app that allows users to book thousands of workout classes and appointments across various studios and gyms.
properties.style_description: Presents a modern, approachable, and high-energy aesthetic that emphasizes convenience, community, and the dynamic nature of movement.
properties.market_positioning: Marketplace for flexible fitness memberships that allows users to pay for classes across a wide network of local studios.
